issues.title: Should have space between 2 button
issues.body:
## 🐞 Bug description
From 'Message Template', we can see some button Edit/ Duplicate / Delete. We should have space between 2 button.
## 🔢 Steps to Reproduce
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Login as admin
2. Go to 'Message Templates' page
3.  Observe buttons Edit/ Duplicate / Delete.
4. Notice no space between 2 button

![image](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/a553c44b-a151-45a2-8b80-3abf3f4afd36)

## ⚙️ Expected behavior
It's better if 2 buttons has space

![image](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/40c8fb9b-2a98-4c83-a55d-de624db3e75b)


## 🖥️ Screenshots


## 💻 System information
 - Browser : Chrome
 - Browser Version : Version 120.0.6099.111
